title: Why Igatpuri is Mumbai's favourite second-home escape
summary: Forests, hills and rivers a short drive from Mumbai: a retreat that is also an investment.
points: A respite from crowded cities, heat and work stress
Lush woodland, hill views and flowing rivers
Row houses, villas and apartments for every budget
Popular with NRIs as well as Mumbaikars

title: How NRIs can invest in Indian real estate
summary: RBI and FEMA rules let NRIs buy homes and offices in India, with repatriation benefits.
points: NRIs can buy any residential or commercial property
Agricultural land, farm houses and plantations are excluded
Property can also be received as a gift or by inheritance
Repatriation of the invested capital is permitted

title: Carpet, built-up, super built-up: which area are you paying for?
summary: RERA requires prices on carpet area. Here's how to read any brochure.
points: Carpet area: usable floor inside your walls
Built-up adds wall thickness and balconies
Super built-up adds a share of lobbies and amenities
Under RERA, sale price must be quoted on carpet area

title: How to check any project on MahaRERA in five minutes
summary: Registration number, approvals, timelines and complaints, all on one public portal.
points: Find the MahaRERA number on the ad or scan its QR code
Search it on maharera.maharashtra.gov.in
Check promised possession date and approvals
Look at quarterly progress updates and any complaints

title: Ready-to-move or under-construction: how to choose
summary: One saves on rent and GST, the other on price and payment flexibility.
points: Ready-to-move: no GST, move in now, see what you buy
Under-construction: lower entry price, staggered payments
Check the developer's delivery record before booking
Factor rent and EMI overlap into your budget
